title: AAC Entitlement Bootstrap 1
description: Defines the canonical AAC Entitlement Bootstrap schema and its serialized data contract.

EntitlementBootstrap.description: Entitlement bootstrap data used to initialize trusted issuers, verifiers, and licensing facilities.

DefaultEntitlementProfile.description: Specifies the default entitlement profile for this entitlement bootstrap.

EntitlementProfiles.description: Lists the entitlement profiles associated with this entitlement bootstrap.

Id.description: Stable identifier of this entitlement profile.

Name.description: Human-readable name of this entitlement profile.

Description.description: Human-readable description of this entitlement profile.

LicensingScopes.description: Lists the licensing scopes associated with this entitlement profile.

Id.description: Stable identifier of this licensing scope.

Type.description: Type discriminator for this licensing scope.

Resolver.description: Specifies the resolver for this licensing scope.

Mandatory.description: Indicates whether mandatory applies to this licensing scope.

EntitlementProviders.description: Lists the entitlement providers associated with this licensing scope.

Id.description: Stable identifier of this entitlement provider.

Name.description: Human-readable name of this licensing scope.

Description.description: Human-readable description of this licensing scope.

EntitlementProviders.description: Lists the entitlement providers associated with this entitlement bootstrap.

Id.description: Stable identifier of this entitlement provider.

Type.description: Type discriminator for this entitlement provider.

Settings.description: Structured settings associated with this entitlement provider.

Name.description: Human-readable name of this entitlement provider.

Description.description: Human-readable description of this entitlement provider.

Metadata.description: Additional structured metadata associated with this entitlement bootstrap.

TrustedIssuers.description: Lists the trusted issuers associated with this entitlement bootstrap.

IssuerId.description: Stable identifier of the issuer associated with this trusted issuer.

ComponentIds.description: Lists stable identifiers associated with this trusted issuer.

EvidenceTypes.description: Lists the evidence types associated with this trusted issuer.

SignerIdentities.description: Lists the signer identities associated with this trusted issuer.

LicensingScopeResolvers.description: Lists the licensing scope resolvers associated with this entitlement bootstrap.

Id.description: Stable identifier of this licensing scope resolver.

Type.description: Type discriminator for this licensing scope resolver.

Settings.description: Structured settings associated with this licensing scope resolver.

Name.description: Human-readable name of this licensing scope resolver.

Description.description: Human-readable description of this licensing scope resolver.

ResourceKey.description: Optional localization resource key for the human-readable text.

displayText.description: Defines the reusable display text structure used by this canonical schema.
